question:
**Choose the correct meaning of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The World Health Organization has finally issued guidelines to prevent the spread of the Covid-19 __epidemic__.

options.text: A large number of people or animals suffering from the same disease at the same time
An infection which is caused by viruses
A disease which lasts for more than fifty years

solution:
the correct answer is: **A large number of people or animals suffering from the same disease at the same time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined word '**Epidemic**' refers to a widespread occurrence of a particular disease. (किसी विशेष रोग की व्यापक घटना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The rapid spread of the virus led to a widespread epidemic in the city.*
 
 
 
• It is a noun and can be used to describe a sudden increase in the number of cases of a disease.
 
• The word is derived from the Greek word '**epi**' meaning '**upon**' and '**demos**' meaning '**people**'.
 
• Other examples of epidemics include the Spanish flu, HIV/AIDS, and Ebola.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
